dataset.citation: Kartik Shenoy, Credit Card Transactions Fraud Detection Dataset, Kaggle, 2020. Generated with Sparkov Data Generation (Brandon Harris, MIT).
dataset.label_definition: 1 = transaction labelled fraudulent by the Sparkov generator that produced it
dataset.license: CC0: Public Domain (Kaggle dataset card, retrieved 2026-09-16)
dataset.name: sparkov
dataset.notes: External synthetic benchmark. Simulated transactions for 1 Jan 2019 - 31 Dec 2020. Kaggle's description advertises 1000 cards and 800 merchants; the published files hold 999 cards and 693 merchant names. Not real card-transaction data.
preprocessing: ids derived with uuid5; raw card numbers never stored
merchant names stripped of the generator's 'fraud_' prefix
categories mapped onto the 12-category canonical taxonomy
card-present derived from the category suffix

notes: Feature matrix read from cache ab0f491b01b01344. seed is the entity-subsampling seed; the model random_state is recorded with the fit, in training_metadata.json.

test_fold_identity.digest_definition: SHA-256 of the fold's transaction ids, in fold order, encoded as a JSON array of strings with no whitespace, in UTF-8
